title: Reassessing the Evidence for the Composite Bow in Ancient Eurasia
core_idea: Reevaluate claims about the origins and development of the full (horn–wood–sinew) composite bow by integrating iconographic and material data within broader archaeological context and supplementing this with genetic evidence, while addressing inconsistent definitions and insufficiently analyzed evidence.
tldr: The paper critiques existing evidence and definitions for early composite bows and aims to reassess their origins and trajectory in Eurasia through combined iconographic, material, archaeological, and genetic approaches, recommending further philological, linguistic, and quantitative (cultural phylogenetic) research.
